== '''William in [https://eternumvn.fandom.com/wiki/Alex%27s_Apartment Alex’s Apartment]''' ==
Orion sits on [[Alex Bardot|Alex]]’s couch as [[William Bardot]] delivers a tense speech about [[The Founder]] and the truth behind ''Eternum''. William Bardot explains that Eternum was not created by the Founder but discovered. The worlds within it always existed, once mistaken by ancient civilizations as the afterlife. A rare few humans, known as Immortals, could enter it naturally, and the Founder was one of them. He later developed the neural implant system that allowed ordinary people to access Eternum, disguising its true nature as advanced technology rather than something far more dangerous.

He goes on to reveal that the Founder controls the souls of the dead, repurposing them as NPCs and bending their will. While some NPCs remain unaware of their state, others, like Thanatos, understand the truth and pursue the Gems for their own reasons. The Gems themselves were not created by the Founder. They are fragments of Eternum’s essence, tied to the cycle of reality itself. Whoever gathers all ten transcends time and space. This is why the Founder must be stopped before he completes the collection and reshapes everything.[[File:Orion hugs Alexx.png|thumb|Orion comforts Alex after William Bardot leaves.]]Outside the apartment, Alex signs the documents that officially disowns her from the Bardot family, filling the air with unspoken frustration and silently breaking Alex down. Orion can choose to comfort her when she breaks down. A few days later, she returns home to find [[Dalia Carter|Dalia]] still absorbed in ''Eternum''. Alex talks to herself about her time with Orion, admitting she’s unsure what their relationship even is anymore.

== '''Dalia and Nancy Gather Intel''' ==
[[File:Eradicator scans Dalia.png|thumb|The Eradicator scans Dalia.]]
In [[Ion]], Dalia is scanned by an [[Eradicator AXR-110|Eradicator]] for infection before continuing her discussion with [[Nancy Carter|Nancy]] and a local informant. The informant shares intel on where [[El Coyote]]’s hideout might be, then soon leaves. Nancy notices the distant look on Dalia’s face and guesses it’s about a boy. She gently tells Dalia that she’s always there if she wants to talk.

== '''Penny at the Mall''' ==
At the mall, [[Penelope Carter|Penny]] sits with [[Lily]] and [[Marco]]. Marco mentions an upcoming party, but Penny declines, saying she’s too focused on the photoshoot and her other commitments. She insists she’s too busy and doesn't feel like partying anymore.

== '''Nova Mentally Prepares''' ==
[[File:Nova learns One Piece has been delayed.png|thumb|Nova learns from Annie that the ''One Piece'' finale has been delayed.]]
In her room, [[Nova Johnson|Nova]] rehearses confessing her feelings for Orion. When she realizes she left her drawing tools at [[The Carters' Home]], she calls [[Annie Winters|Annie]]—who already has them and says she will give them to her at the café. During the call, Annie mentions that the ''[https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/One_Piece One Piece]'' finale has been canceled. Nova is devastated and drops her phone, ending the call abruptly.

== '''Luna and Orion at the Café''' ==
[[File:Annie high-fives Luna.png|thumb|Annie mistakenly high fives Luna.]]
Orion meets [[Luna Hernandez|Luna]] at the café, and they talk for a while about her book before he notices she isn’t wearing her gloves. Luna explains that since it’s just the two of them, she finally feels comfortable enough to take them off. Orion reaches out and holds her hand, but their quiet moment is interrupted when Annie walks in. Annie says she’s meeting Nova soon and dropped by early to say hi after remembering they were there. Luna stands to leave and waves goodbye, but Annie mistakes the gesture for a high-five. When their hands meet, Luna is hit with a sudden vision. She keeps the details vague, and Orion quickly steers the conversation away to keep Annie from realizing what just happened.

== '''Orion Remembers Calypso’s Ritual''' ==
Before meeting Luna in [[Ekabar]], Orion thinks back to his last encounter with [[Calypso]] the day before. She was performing the Elarisil—a ritual meant to focus all her magic toward finding a way back to [[Hyril'ar]]. It demanded complete isolation, she didn’t know how long it would take—days, maybe even weeks. Before beginning, Calypso told Orion not to disturb her for any reason, no matter what happened.

== '''Journey to Hollowbrook''' ==
Orion meets up with Luna, who surprises him with an outfit she put together herself. When he asks about her earlier vision, she dodges the question, brushing it off with a faint smile. Together they travel to Hollowbrook, and along the way, Luna tells him about her early days in Eternum—how she used to hide out in old barns just to feel safe. When they arrive, Penny spots them and quickly waves them into a nearby house, urging them to stay quiet until the coast is clear. Once things settle, she greets them warmly, and the three of them head toward the town square to look for someone who might have the information they need.

== '''Town Square Ambush and Strategy''' ==
[[File:Hunters trail Orion.png|thumb|The hunters watching Orion.]]
As the group enters the town square, hunters drop from the rooftops, quickly surrounding them. Orion steps forward, insisting on joining their mission, but [[Father Bakhar]] dismisses him and orders Penny and Luna to stay in town—claiming women have no place among hunters. After a tense standoff, the leader begrudgingly allows them to do as they please, warning only that they must not lead any monsters back to Hollowbrook.

The hunters brief the trio on the locations of nearby vampires and werewolves. Penny proposes a plan: she’ll handle the vampires, Luna will go after the werewolves, and Orion will stay behind in case of any attacks.

Later that night, Orion sits alone, restless and uncertain. He pulls out a coin and flips it to decide whether to go after one of them. The coin lands on whichever side he picks, and he must decide who to go after.

== '''Choosing a path''' ==

=== '''''Orion and Luna Meet the Werewolves''''' ===
[[File:Duke roars at Luna.png|thumb|A Werewolf roars at Luna.]]
If Orion decides to find Luna and spots her near an old castle, only for her to jump-scare him. When he admits he missed her, she opens up about being distant lately because of exams and [[Loco's Cafe]]. They explore the courtyard, find nothing, and head inside—only to be ambushed by two massive werewolves. Luna tells Orion not to attack, saying they won’t harm them if left alone.

The werewolves, [[Duke and Burpee]], are surprised by Luna’s calmness. She points out that one of them carefully stepped around a flower—proof they’re not mindless beasts. Impressed, they invite the pair to meet their leader, [[Fangrend]].

Inside, Fangrend dismisses his pack and tells them to leave, but agrees to answer Orion’s questions if he can defeat him in a duel. Fangrend shifts into his human form—completely naked. Orion hesitates, asking if he has to do the same. Fangrend smirks and says, “Only if your lady friend doesn’t mind.” Luna, completely unfazed, replies, “Nah, it’s perfectly fine. Go ahead and strip.”

Orion reluctantly does so, He notices Luna looking at him. Fangrend eventually warns that the nudity might be distracting—especially since Betty, a female werewolf, can’t stop staring—so both men put on loincloths. Luna tells Orion he doesn’t need to go through with it, but he insists.

After the duel’s terms are clarified, and Orion passes Fangrend’s test, He lets Orion ask his questions. When they finish, Luna thanks Duke and Burpee for their help. As she and Orion head back to Hollowbrook, she wonders if Penny found the vampires—and if they turned out to be as friendly as the werewolves. Orion suddenly senses they’re being followed. He tells Luna to go on ahead while he investigates.

=== '''''Orion and Penny Meet the Vampires''''' ===
[[File:Penny interrogates Orion.png|thumb|Penny ambushes and questions Orion.]]
If Orion decides to look for Penny and ends up at an old cemetery. As he searches, Penny suddenly ambushes him, pinning him against a wall. Suspicious, she accuses him of being a demon impersonating Orion—just like the boggle from the [[Warthogs]] incident. She demands proof he’s really himself. If Orion mentions the Reminiscecombobulator, and Penny’s expression softens. “What made you think of that?” she asks. Orion replies that it’s one of his favorite memories. 

Penny tells him she’s been tracking the vampires and that while they’re fast and numerous, they’re not exactly clever. If they plan right, they can outsmart them. She adds that she tried using magic on one earlier, but it didn’t work—they’re immune.
[[File:Mortimer introduces himself.png|thumb|Mortimer introduces himself to Orion and Penny.]]
Before they can plan further, a vampire lunges out of the shadows. Orion pushes Penny behind him as the creature charges—only for a blade to pierce its skull from behind. The attacker drops instantly. Standing over it is another vampire—composed, calm, and oddly polite. He introduces himself as [[Mortimer]] and welcomes them to [[Lord and Lady Iliescu|Lord Iliescu's]] residence.

Mortimer leads them to the manor, where they meet Lord Lazarus Iliescu and his wife, [[Lord and Lady Iliescu|Lady Lysandra]]. Lord Iliescu greets them kindly, but Lady Iliescu’s eyes linger on Orion. She comments that he’d make a fine vampire someday. Her strange tone prompts Lord Iliescu to explain that the curse corrupting their kind is beginning to consume her too. He tells them vampires once lived peacefully until the curse turned most into mindless beasts—Mortimer being the only one who resisted.
[[File:Penny and Orions dance.png|thumb|Penny and Orion waltz together.]]
Before answering their questions, Lord Iliescu requests one small favor: help him remind his wife of who she once was—through a dance. Orion takes Penny’s hand, smiling, and says it’s finally time he gave her the waltz he owed her. The two dance gracefully as Lady Iliescu watches.

When the song ends, she applauds softly, momentarily lucid. Lord Iliescu thanks them for their kindness, and answers Orion’s questions. After the questions, Penny and Orion head back to Hollowbrook, Penny smiles, saying it feels good to have allies. But Orion suddenly pauses—he senses they’re not alone. He tells Penny to go on ahead while he turns to face whatever’s following them.

=== '''Dalia Flashback''' ===
Before Orion faces off with Fangrend or nearly fights a vampire—he recalls a training session with Dalia from the day before. She had been helping him sharpen his skills against larger opponents, and everything was going well—until Orion started zoning out. Dalia, wearing very short shorts, inadvertently caught his attention, and he found it hard to focus on the exercises.

Noticing his distraction, Dalia called him out. She teased that she had a surprise for him, but since he wasn’t paying attention, he wouldn’t be getting it. Determined, Orion begged for another chance. Dalia smirked and laid down a challenge: if he could do 300 pushups in a row within a week, she might consider giving him the surprise.

== '''Luna Comforts Sybilla and Shares a Moment with Orion''' ==
Back in Hollowbrook, Luna grows concerned when Penny doesn’t return. Following the sound of crying, she finds [[Sybilla]], a small girl upset that she isn’t allowed outside at night because of the monsters. Luna reassures her they’ll wait together until dawn.

Sybilla remains doubtful, citing [[Sybilla's Mother|her mother's]] strict rules. Luna recalls a similar situation with Anne on the Red Herring server and tells Sybilla that everything turned out fine. To help calm her, Luna summons [[Zippy and Maurice]]. Sybilla begins to settle, but then her mother appears, calling Luna a witch and warning her away—reminding Luna of when a Boggle, disguised as her mother, had done the same at Warthogs.

Meanwhile, Orion returns to the village and is confronted by a hunter for harboring a witch. Concerned for Luna, he searches for her and finds her in a barn. Luna assures him she’s safe and explains that if the hunters aren’t after him, he should leave with Penny. If Orion refuses then they sit down to wait for sunrise.
[[File:Orion and Luna kiss in Hollowbrook.png|thumb|Orion and Luna share a kiss.]]
Luna opens up about her past, sharing how she was bullied for having visions and how her father was the only person who supported her. Orion reassures her that she doesn’t have to face everything alone, encouraging her to share her thoughts so he can help. Luna then draws him in for a kiss, and they share a romantic scene together.

== '''Hollowbrook Showdown''' ==
[[File:Father Bakhar confronts Orion.png|thumb|Father Bakhar confronts Orion]]
The next morning in Hollowbrook, Luna and Orion met up with Penny, who filled them in on the situation with the hunters. Suddenly, Father Bakhar appeared, aiming his dimeritium gun at the group, ready to drain all their magic. Just as he tried to fire, a vampire stepped in, swapping the gun for a violin, and when Father Bakhar tried to shot a violin, Duke and Burpee were left laughing. Fangrend then knocked Bakhar out from behind, planning to take him to his sanctuary, while Lord Iliescu appeared from the shadows to explain that his kin could move faster than human perception. With the immediate threat neutralized, the vampires and werewolves said their final goodbyes, and everyone returned safely to the real world. Luna and Orion text each other good night before going to sleep.

== '''Orion at School''' ==
Orion zones out in [[Mr. Keating]]’s class but answers every question correctly. In the hall, he talks briefly with [[Chang Wong|Chang]] about going on a date with [[Micaela Garcia|Micaela]]. 

== '''Penny’s Photoshoot''' ==
Penny met up with Orion, and the two exchanged playful, flirty banter before heading toward the photo studio. On the way, Penny stopped to use the restroom, where she reflected on her day—her conversation with Nova about the One Piece delay, her joking admission that she no longer liked Orion, and her chat with Lily about her new Neural Implant. The reminders of her earlier interactions made Penny uneasy about her feelings, and she resolved to put boys on the back burner for now. Once composed, she left the restroom and walked with Orion to the studio, where [[Philippe]] scolded her for being late before whisking her away to get her hair done.

While Penny prepared, Orion noticed several cars covered with tarps and almost peeked under one before [[Aspen]] intervened, explaining that Penny’s shoot had been moved for a higher-profile client. After some convincing, Orion got Aspen to cooperate, and Penny overheard him firmly standing his ground. Aspen then asked Penny a few background questions before Orion began taking photos. Once he was done and Aspen had left, Penny changed out of her designer dress, and the two shared a romantic moment. Their moment was nearly interrupted when [[Mr. Valentino]] barged in, yelling at Aspen, but Penny and Orion managed to leave just in time without being caught.

== Orion’s Dream ==
[[File:Screenshot 20241014 222046.jpg|thumb|Idriel appears in Orion's dreams.]]
Orion awakens in complete darkness, confused and disoriented. When he tries to move, he realizes a chain is locked around his neck, binding him to a stone pillar. Panic sets in as he calls out for help—until a familiar voice answers. It’s [[Idriel]]. She tells him this isn’t his prison, but hers, and that he’s in the Limbo—a place beyond space and time, where neither flow nor stillness exists. Orion struggles to understand. To free the NPC’s Idriel tells him he must collect the ten [[Gem of Doom|Gem of Dooms]], but she says that he’ll forget everything once he leaves, he always does. When Orion demands to know the point of their talk, Idriel says he still isn’t asking the right question and urges him to keep moving forward, to defy fate, and to “break the chains.”

Orion then wakes up in his bed and answers a text from Penny saying, She, Dalia, and Annie are at the gym.

== '''Nancy and Orion''' ==
As Orion heads out of his room, he runs into Nancy doing laundry. She mentions she's finishing up some chores before logging on to play with him and Nova. After a few flirty exchanges, Nancy returns to her tasks, and Orion heads off to Nova’s house. 

== '''Nova’s House''' ==
When Orion arrives at Nova’s house, she pretends she forgot their plans, though her mom, [[Sandra Johnson|Sandra]], quickly exposes her by mentioning she spent all of yesterday preparing. Flustered, Nova shoves her mom out of the room and apologizes to Orion before they settle into the guest room to log into ''Eternum''. Despite the awkward start, their comfort returns quickly as they prepare to meet up with Nancy in ''The [[New World]]''.

== '''The New World''' ==
[[File:El Coyote holds Maximo at gunpoint.png|thumb|El Coyote holds Maximo hostage.]]
Hours later, the trio has been drifting aimlessly at sea. Orion complains about feeling seasick while Nova teases him, but his mood lifts when Nancy cheers him up. Taking charge, she calls out to [[Maximo]] and orders him to tell the crew they’re heading back to Tortuga at full speed. When Maximo doesn’t come back, everyone grows uneasy. Orion senses someone nearby and demands they reveal themselves. From the shadows steps [[El Coyote|Boone–the real El coyote]]—holding Maximo at gunpoint. El coyote taunts them, revealing that the man Orion killed was only a decoy. After Orion negotiates for Maximo’s release, he rushes Boone, only to find it’s another Decoy.

El Coyote explains he needs Orion to retrieve the Heart of the Abyss from the Island of the Lost Souls before sunrise, offering the Gem of Doom in return. He instructs Orion to find a Gypsy Goldtooth in Tortuga who holds the map. Once El Coyote vanishes, Orion insists they must return to Tortuga to prepare. Nova is upset as she wanted to spend time with Orion but Orion didn't notice. Nova walks away and Nancy lectures him about what he said, before saying they can spare a few hours at Tortuga for him to spend time with Nova.

Back on Tortuga, Orion finds Gypsy Goldtooth who is really just [[Wenlin]]. Orion buys the map and [[Chop-Chop]] offers him Polyjuice potion for one thousand [[Eternals]].
[[File:Nova and Orion share their first kiss.png|thumb|Nova and Orion romance in the real world.]]
Back in the real world, Nova is clearly upset, but Orion proves how much he cares—finding her, pulling her close, and telling her how he feels, leading into a romantic scene.

== '''Orion is shot''' ==
After Orion and Nova’s scene, Orion goes out for pizza where he takes a shortcut through Chinatown. He is ambushed by two thugs, punches one, but is soon shot. As he lays on the wet cement, he briefly sees Idriel who is disappointed in him, before the chapter comes to an end.
